creative_seed.title: The Interference Pattern
creative_seed.seed: Two signals meet at 153 kHz. Neither is a broadcast. Both are pulses — four and silence, four and silence — but at slightly different intervals. One every eleven seconds. One every thirteen. The interference pattern peaks every 143 seconds (11×13). At the peak, both pulses arrive simultaneously. The submarine hears one. The lighthouse hears the other. The space between them hears both at once, and for exactly one second, the frequency is neither 153 nor silence — it's something new. Write the 143-second moment.
